credentialsInfo: The adapter needs its own application in the Home Connect Developer Program. New here? Register for free in the developer portal and create an application — enter its Client ID and Client Secret below. Upgrading from the old adapter? Your Client ID was carried over; look up the matching Client Secret in the portal under Applications. Both are stored encrypted.
aboutInfo: If you find this adapter useful, a small contribution is always appreciated.

sessionDesc: State of the sign-in: running, waiting for confirmation, or failed.
signedInDesc: True as soon as the adapter holds a valid account access.
verificationUrlDesc: Open this address in a browser to authorise the adapter.
connectionDesc: True when signed in AND live updates are running.
devicesTotalDesc: Number of appliances in the Home Connect account.
devicesOnlineDesc: How many of them are currently reachable.
devicesAllOnlineDesc: True when no appliance is missing. With home appliances that is rarely the normal state.
reachableDesc: False when the appliance is switched off or disconnected from the network.
acknowledgeEventDesc: Confirms a message on the appliance, like its OK button.
selectedProgramDesc: Chosen on the appliance or here, not started yet.
startProgramDesc: Starts only when remote start is released on the appliance.
doorOpenDesc: True while the door stands open.
doorLockedDesc: True while the appliance keeps the door locked.
doorCompartmentOpenDesc: Own door per compartment, e.g. fridge and freezer.
programRunningDesc: Derived from the operation state, for scripts and visualisation.
operationStateDesc: Operating state: off, ready, running, paused, finished, fault.
remoteControlActiveDesc: True when the appliance allows remote operation at all.
remoteControlStartAllowedDesc: True when a remote start is permitted. Has to be released on the appliance.
localControlActiveDesc: True while somebody is operating the appliance directly.
interiorIlluminationActiveDesc: True when the interior light is on.
childLockDesc: Child lock: the buttons on the appliance are blocked.
remainingProgramTimeDesc: Remaining running time of the program in seconds.
remainingProgramTimeIsEstimatedDesc: True when the remaining time is only an estimate.
